_comment: CSS selectors used only by the Playwright (headless browser) fallback, when a retailer's page doesn't expose parseable JSON-LD data. Retailers change their markup often, so each field lists candidate selectors tried in order (first match wins). If the scraper starts returning zero results for a retailer, open that retailer's search page in a real browser, inspect a product tile with devtools, and add the new selector to the matching array here -- no code changes needed.
